verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing's own docs describe a testing guide for simulating test purchases before going live, which covers the core idea of exercising card transactions in a sandbox. The real-time authorization webhook used to approve or decline requests is the auth logic such tests would exercise. However, the evidence never says which lifecycle stages can be simulated. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of simulating clearings/captures, reversals, refunds, and declines; detail on the scope of test-mode authorization simulation; independent or hands-on corroboration.
